newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela bolivar ends softer at 484/485/dlr.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela bolivar ends softer at 484/485/dlr.

text.p: The Venezuelan bolivar closed softer in quiet trade at 484.00/485.00 per dollar as banks bought back some of the dollars they sold Wednesday to meet high bolivar demand, traders said.
The bolivar ended markedly stronger Wednesday at 483.50/484.50 per dollar as banks bought bolivars to meet a liquidity crunch that had sent interbank lending rates soaring to 90 percent.
"It was much calmer today ... a day of re-buying (dollars)", said one trader, adding that interest rates on the interbank market had dropped to between 45 and 70 percent.
"The session was much better balanced between dollar buyers and sellers and there were few strong movements in the exchange rate either way," said another broker.
